# Slovenia

[global-law](../) / Slovenia

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 71% | 87% | not applicable | 0% |

Broad national record: 1,971 laws in force from PIS (700 ordinary laws, 1,271 ratification laws) as their current text, plus the Constitution and the Elections Act with full dated history, current to 2026-10-30. But two of the eight essentials, the Obligacijski zakonik and the Zakon o pravdnem postopku, are not in the repository at all (only their amending acts OZ-A and ZPP-E are), no case law is held, and the README still describes a two-act repository with paths that no longer exist.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
